description: MainActivity.kt is the main UI activity of an Android app that provides a video player interface with features like language selection, subtitles, translation toggle, CC toggle, and playback controls. It initializes and manages ExoPlayer, handles user interactions, and updates UI components based on playback state and user settings.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Primary activity handling video playback, UI controls, language selection, and subtitles in an Android app using ExoPlayer.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method that initializes UI components, ViewModel, and the media player, and sets up event listeners.

methods.name: setSpinnerSelection
methods.description: Sets the dropdown (spinner) selection based on the provided language string.

methods.name: initPlayerAndStart
methods.description: Initializes the ExoPlayer instance, sets the media source, and starts playback.

methods.name: updatePlayPauseIcon
methods.description: Updates the play/pause button icon based on current playback state.

methods.name: updateMuteIcon
methods.description: Updates the mute/unmute button icon based on current volume.
